columns.$description: Slice 5c: columns in the Stickers tab grid of the emoji window. The same number is in the code as STICKER_COLUMNS (the arrow keys move by a row); the test stickers/stickerTokens.test.ts compares both.

gif-columns.$description: Slice 5c: columns in the GIFs tab grid. The same number is in the code as GIF_COLUMNS; the same test compares both.

sticker.$description: Stickers and GIFs (slice 5c): the emoji window's Stickers and GIFs tabs, the sticker in the feed, the GIF badge. A picture is content, not text, so the sizes in px do not grow with the text scale.

long-side.$description: The long side of a sticker in the feed (Telegram draws one at about this size): the box is fitted to it from the sticker's width and height before the picture loads, so nothing jumps.

fallback-glyph.$description: The size of the emoji that stands in the box of a sticker whose file is missing or cannot be decoded: half the long side, so the glyph fits the box.

strip-icon.$description: The side of a pack icon in the strip above the sticker grid, and the height of the strip's buttons.

strip-gap.$description: Gap between the pack icons of the strip.

cell-padding.$description: Padding inside a sticker cell of the grid, around the picture.

gif-gap.$description: Gap between the still frames of the GIFs tab.

gif-radius.$description: Corners of a still frame in the GIFs tab.

badge-inset.$description: How far the GIF badge stands from the corner of a still frame or a cell.
